summary: Full backend + frontend validation of RightPolicy homepage. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases passing (health, inquiries POST/GET incl. 422 validation, policy-uploads POST/GET incl. 400 for .exe, 413 for >15MB). Frontend: homepage renders all 12 sections, Navbar 'Talk to an Advisor' opens advisor dialog, valid submit closes dialog + shows toast (POST /api/inquiries 201), Hero 'Upload Existing Policy' opens upload dialog, PDF submit closes dialog + shows toast (POST /api/policy-uploads 201), FAQ accordion expands and collapses, Services renders 6 cards with 6 Learn More buttons, WhyRightPolicy comparison has 6 rows with typical/rp cells, mobile toggle opens mobile menu. No blocking issues.

issues: All sections render cleanly with warm off-white + deep navy + refined red palette; no contrast issues spotted in tested viewports (1920x1080 and 390x844).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: EmailStr used only on POST; Inquiry response model uses plain str - fine. Consider adding a response_model=None error schema and persisting an index on created_at for inquiries/policy_uploads for scale.
server.py: upload_policy writes chunks to disk before rejecting on size; correct cleanup via unlink(missing_ok=True) is in place. Good.
server.py: Inquiry.message default is '' but model declares Optional[str] - works; consistent.

Frontend data-testids present across Navbar, Hero, Services (service-card-*, service-learn-more-*), Advisor/Upload dialog forms, FAQ (faq-item-*), WhyRightPolicy (compare-row-label-*). Naming differs slightly from review_request (advisor-form-* vs advisor-name-input) — main agent may want to align docs with actual testids, but tests pass as-is.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Test data inserted via TEST_ prefixed records in inquiries and policy_uploads collections (small PDF ~4KB stored in /app/backend/uploads).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend API contract stable. Dialog form testids use pattern advisor-form-{name|email|phone|type|message|submit} and upload-form-{name|email|phone|file|notes|submit}. FAQ items: faq-item-0..N. WhyRightPolicy rows: compare-row-label-0..5. Navbar mobile toggle: navbar-mobile-toggle, menu: navbar-mobile-menu. Public URL via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
